title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on mlx-flash: 4.4 tok/s via SSD expert streaming on a 64GB Mac
slug_note: A 224GB 4-bit MoE served from a 64GB Mac by keeping hot experts in RAM and streaming cold ones from SSD: 4.4 tok/s reported.

variation.quant_detail: 4-bit MLX; mlx-flash streams cold MoE experts from SSD and caches predicted-hot experts in RAM

engine.config: mlx-flash runtime: SSD expert streaming with mixed-precision expert tiers and an adaptive RAM cache driven by macOS vm_statistics64 pressure

requirements.notes: Weights far exceed RAM by design; szibis quotes a ~209GB working set streamed from SSD with the hot-expert cache filling available RAM.

steps.text: Point it at mlx-community/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-4bit on fast NVMe SSD storage
Serve; cold experts stream from disk while hot experts stay resident

measurements.method: mlx-flash benchmark quoted in the repo README
measurements.note: Qwen3.5-397B MoE (~209GB working set) on a 64GB Mac via SSD streaming; crashes/OOM without mlx-flash

caveats: The model exceeds RAM on every local machine listed: it only runs via SSD expert streaming (this row, at the 4.4 tok/s measured) or a multi-GPU split.
Uniform 4-bit quantization of this generation costs +20.6% NLL/token vs BF16 per PipeNetwork's Flash-Next ablation; mlx-flash's mixed precision mitigates but does not erase quant loss.
The 4.4 tok/s figure is a builder-quoted single-stream number with no further method detail.
